verdict.rationale: Agents can read and post channel messages through official surfaces: the documented NIP-29 relay protocol (group chat kind:9), the Buzz CLI used by the buzz-acp harness, and the managed-agent skill covering messaging. Access control uses per-agent Nostr keypairs plus channel memberships rather than scoped API tokens, and token auth was deliberately removed on the admin API. Probes found no OpenAPI or REST spec. Missing for 10: scoped API tokens with explicit read/write scopes, a documented REST/bot API with a published spec, independent hands-on corroboration of agent read/post flows.
